_pipelines: Twenty pipelines to watch. [] means every pipeline.
_include_unassigned: Also watch deals with no pipeline set (usually mis-keyed E&S deals).
_poll_seconds: Seconds between polls. Polls are incremental (only deals edited since the last one), with a full fetch every 2 min, so 5s stays well under Twenty's 100 requests/min.
_quiet_hours: [start, end] local hours to hold messages, e.g. [22, 7]. [] = always send.
_new_deal_settle_minutes: A deal row exists the moment someone clicks New in Twenty. Hold it until nobody has edited it for this many minutes.
_new_deal_required_fields: Fields that must be filled before a new deal counts as submitted: name, company, owner, amount.
_notify_appointed: Ping when a rep flips the Appointed toggle on a company.
_notify_removed: Card when a deal is deleted or leaves the pipeline. Off: Harry does not want these.
_burst_notify: Off: a bulk stage change is swallowed silently (still logged and tagged in history), rather than announced.
_notify_unappointed: Off: Harry does not want Appointed -> not appointed pings.
_hidden_stages: Stages the bot ignores: no pings, left out of /pipeline, /deals, /quotes and reports.
_history_since: Reports ignore Twenty timeline/creates before this: the old->new Twenty migration copied and re-staged deals in bulk on 6-7 Oct.
_require_submitted_flag: Off (Harry 2026-10-12): reps don't tick Submitted on hand-keyed deals, so 6 never pinged. A deal goes out once it has a name and nobody has edited it for new_deal_settle_minutes; a ticked box still goes out at once.
_rep_telegram: Deal Owner name (substring, case-insensitive) -> Telegram username; the card tags them
_quote_checker: Tagged on a new deal card that didn't land at Quote Sent
